Hi Aparna —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 30‑minute discovery and a suggested set of next steps.

High‑level fit
- Primary goal: reduce average inference latency for recommendation API from ~220ms → 80–100ms while cutting per‑prediction cost by ~40%.
- Key constraints: must run in us‑east on provider X, data residency for PII, and no shared customer data in model training.

What we heard
1) Production traffic: ~200 qps at peak, spiky daytime pattern
2) Current stack: in‑house model served in Kubernetes; considering moving to dedicated inference for predictable SLAs
3) Procurement timeline: evaluating options in Q2, decision target by mid‑May

Suggested next steps
- Option A (Pilot): 6‑week dedicated pilot with 2 GPUs (predictable throughput) — technical deep dive + sample workload required
- Option B (PoC): 2‑week eval on hosted API (no infra changes) for end‑to‑end latency numbers

Can you confirm which option sounds closest to Vendrive's appetite and whether your engineering lead (Liam) is available for a 30‑minute technical sync next week? If yes, I can send calendar options.

Attachments: discovery-notes-vendrive-20270418.pdf (call notes), redwood-one-pager.pdf

Thanks,
— Soojin
